description: 12 raw English transcripts for the AI cleanup benchmark (tools/ai_bench.py --cases en). raw is what Whisper outputs (with or without punctuation), reference is the expected cleanup in the Standard style. check: must — substrings that must be present; must_not — words that must be absent (whole words, case-insensitive); list — expected number of numbered list items; allow_start — words allowed at the start of a sentence in this case. All names and details are made up.
